# Drop orphaned Portal sitemap/llms bloat and sync seo.json in prepare

## Context

Owned directly by `@neo-gemini-julia` under `#20671` ahead of the Engine 14 cut (`#21033` / `#21775`), so contributor labels (`good first issue`, `help wanted`) are omitted.

Inspecting `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` and the SEO generator pipeline in `buildScripts/docs/seo/*.mjs` plus `buildScripts/release/prepare.mjs` surfaced two coupled defects on `dev`:

1. **2.24 MB (`79,215` lines) of orphaned generated Portal crawler bloat is still tracked in `neomjs/neo`:**
   - `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` (`78,772` lines, `2.2 MB`) is a frozen `2026-08-30` (`7ecd6b8b6e`) `<urlset>` monolith advertising `/home` and `19k+` raw ticket/PR routes, whereas the real deployed `https://neomjs.com/sitemap.xml` is an `11`-line (`369 B`) `<sitemapindex>` referencing `sitemap-core.xml` and `sitemap-discussions.xml`.
   - `apps/portal/llms.txt` (`443` lines, `36 KB`) carries a broken `- [v13.4.0 (2026-11-09): Update](...)` placeholder at line 33 that violates `validateLlmsTxtContent` (`buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs:380`).
   - Eight recent PRs (`#20931`, `#20994`, `#21003`, `#21182`, `#21278`, `#21362`, `#21435`, `#21495`) hand-edited `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt` assuming they were live, while `neomjs/pages` (`buildScripts/updateNeoVersion.mjs:236-245`) regenerates `sitemap*.xml` and `llms*.txt` from `--corpus-root` at deploy time and `.npmignore:17-18` excludes both from the npm tarball.
2. **`node buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` currently fails on `dev`, and `buildScripts/release/prepare.mjs` leaves `seo.json` stale across releases:**
   ```text
   Error: apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json is out of date with getSeoJson(). Run: node buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs -f seo-json -o apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json
       at runCli (buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs:870:19)
   ```
   `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` on `dev` holds `380` routes vs `392` expected — missing `12` standalone Engine 14 example routes (`/examples/board/{bigData,cardEditor,columns,multiSelect}/index.html`, `/examples/gantt/{dependencies,taskColumns,taskEditor}/index.html`, `/examples/scheduler/{eventEditor,liveUpdates,resourceColumns,timeZones,zoom}/index.html`) and carrying `45` stale `lastmod` / `v14.0.0` release-note entries.

## The Problem

1. When `#19322` (`7ff8467baa`) removed `resources/content/` and `data-sync-pipeline.yml` from `neomjs/neo`, and `#19408` (`4658fbfa00`) removed `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo()` from `buildScripts/release/prepare.mjs:108-111` (because `sitemap*.xml` and `llms*.txt` require `--corpus-root`), neither PR deleted the orphaned `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` and `apps/portal/llms.txt` files or added them to `.gitignore`, and `.npmignore:14-18` kept a false comment claiming *"Tracked so the deployment can serve them... Regenerated by the release prepare step"*.
2. Unlike `sitemap*.xml` and `llms*.txt`, `getSeoJson()` (`buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs:819`) requires **zero** `--corpus-root` (`learn/`, `apps/`, `examples/`, and `.github/RELEASE_NOTES` all live in `neomjs/neo`) — and **must** run inside `neomjs/neo` where `.git` history exists! When `neomjs/pages` runs `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs` inside `node_modules/neo.mjs`, `hasReliableGitHistory()` (`gitLastmod.mjs:40`) is `false`, so `getSeoJson()` and `getSitemapXml()` depend on the pre-baked `lastmod` dates shipped inside `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`. Skipping `getSeoJson()` in `buildScripts/release/prepare.mjs` leaves new routes without `<lastmod>` in `sitemap-core.xml` and ships stale `v14.0.0` metadata at release time.
3. `verify.mjs` (`runCli`, lines 850–938) validates `sitemapIndexXml` and `llmsTxt` only in memory, never failing when stale `apps/portal/sitemap*.xml` or `apps/portal/llms*.txt` artifacts are left on disk in the corpus-less Engine checkout.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: `learn/agentos/decisions/0018-neo-identity-source-of-truth-model.md` §3.2 (*"Generate — the surface is fully emitted from source (e.g. `llms.txt`/`sitemap.xml` from `generate.mjs`); fix the generator, never the output"*) and `buildScripts/release/prepare.mjs:3-7` (*"rebuilds the Portal indexes whose sources the engine holds"*).

- **Remove vs. update decision on `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` and `apps/portal/llms.txt`:** **Remove (`git rm`) + `.gitignore`**, not update. In `neomjs/neo`, `--corpus-root` does not exist, so a valid `sitemap-discussions.xml` or `llms-all.txt` cannot be built here, `sitemap.xml`'s child `<loc>https://neomjs.com/sitemap-discussions.xml</loc>` has no sibling in `apps/portal/`, zero runtime or test modules read `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt`, `.npmignore` already excluded both from npm, and `neomjs/pages` (`buildScripts/updateNeoVersion.mjs:236-245`) regenerates all 7 SEO/LLM files from pinned `github-content-sync` before `npm run build-all` (`copy.mjs`).
- **`.gitignore` + `.npmignore` interaction (`buildScripts/util/npmIgnoreComposition.mjs:11-18`):** Once `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` and `apps/portal/llms.txt` are untracked (`git rm`) and `/apps/portal/sitemap*.xml` + `/apps/portal/llms*.txt` live in `.gitignore`, `.gitignore` still matches zero tracked files (`checkPackageContents.spec.mjs` invariant) and `prepack` composes those ignore rules into `.npmignore` automatically for dirty working trees, allowing the stale 6-line block in `.npmignore:13-18` to be deleted cleanly.
- **`apps/portal/resources/data/{tickets,pulls,discussions}` remain untouched:** Unlike `sitemap.xml` and `llms.txt`, Portal stores (`apps/portal/store/Discussions.mjs:23`, etc.) read those JSON indexes during local development (`#19408`).

## The Fix

1. **Delete orphaned Portal crawler files & ignore generated outputs in `neomjs/neo`:**
   - `git rm apps/portal/sitemap.xml apps/portal/llms.txt`.
   - Add `/apps/portal/sitemap*.xml` and `/apps/portal/llms*.txt` to `.gitignore`.
   - Remove the obsolete comment and `/apps/portal/sitemap.xml` + `/apps/portal/llms.txt` header entries from `.npmignore:13-18`, and update the explanatory comment in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/checkPackageContents.spec.mjs:170-174`.
2. **Sync `seo.json` and run fail-closed verification in `buildScripts/release/prepare.mjs`:**
   - After `await createReleaseIndex({releaseNotesRoot: getEngineReleaseNotesRoot(root)})` in `buildScripts/release/prepare.mjs`, regenerate and write `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` via `getSeoJson({releaseNotesRoot: getEngineReleaseNotesRoot(root), root})` so release cuts (`#21775`) pre-bake accurate git `lastmod` dates and stamped release-note metadata before `npm publish`.
3. **Fail closed on stray Engine-side `sitemap*.xml` / `llms*.txt` files in `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs`:**
   - Export a helper (e.g. `findDisallowedCorpusLessPortalFiles(root)`) invoked by `verify.mjs` `runCli` when `--corpus-root` is not passed, throwing an actionable `Error` if any `apps/portal/sitemap*.xml` or `apps/portal/llms*.txt` file exists on disk in the Engine checkout.
   - Regenerate `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` (`392` routes) so `node buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` passes green on `dev`.
   - Add unit test coverage in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Verify.spec.mjs`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1:** `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` (`78,772` lines) and `apps/portal/llms.txt` (`443` lines) are removed from git tracking, `/apps/portal/sitemap*.xml` and `/apps/portal/llms*.txt` are added to `.gitignore`, `.npmignore:13-18` removes the obsolete rules/comment, and `npm run check-package-contents` plus `checkPackageContents.spec.mjs` pass.
- [ ] **AC-2:** `buildScripts/release/prepare.mjs` regenerates `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` via `getSeoJson()` using the Engine's `releaseNotesRoot`, and `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` on `dev` is refreshed (`392` routes, including all `12` missing `board`/`gantt`/`scheduler` standalone routes).
- [ ] **AC-3:** `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` fails closed in corpus-less mode when any `apps/portal/sitemap*.xml` or `apps/portal/llms*.txt` file exists on disk, `node buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` exits `0` on `dev`, and `Verify.spec.mjs` covers both clean and stray-file cases.

## Out of Scope

- Splitting `examples.json` / `example-captures.json` / `seo.json` per example family to eliminate cross-PR merge conflicts (tracked in `#21539`).
- Removing `apps/portal/resources/data/{tickets,pulls,discussions}`, which local-dev Portal stores still fetch (`#19408`).
- `neomjs/pages` and Google Search Console sitemap console cleanup (`business#82`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Keeping and regenerating a partial `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` inside `neomjs/neo`:** `sitemap.xml` is a `<sitemapindex>` referencing `sitemap-discussions.xml`, which cannot be built without `--corpus-root`, and `neomjs/pages` overwrites `apps/portal/sitemap*.xml` from pinned `github-content-sync` on every deploy anyway — keeping any tracked `sitemap.xml` in `neomjs/neo` only recreates stale merge-conflict bloat.
- **Leaving `/apps/portal/sitemap.xml` in `.npmignore` after adding `/apps/portal/sitemap*.xml` to `.gitignore`:** `npmIgnoreComposition.mjs` drops `.gitignore` rules owned by `.npmignore` headers; removing the header entries once untracked keeps one authoritative ignore rule in `.gitignore`.
